description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art character with a green hime cut: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask, at both sides of the figure seen from the front: the long straight hair that hangs down her back shows on both sides of the body, falling from behind the ears past the shoulders straight down to the waist, two long straight sections in big bold locks, the same bright grass green as the hair above, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. Do not change the face, the ears, the bangs, the side locks, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
